headline: Sensex Slips While Nifty Gains; Metals And Smallcaps Shine Amid Mixed Cues
why: Metals and FMCG sectors saw significant buying interest ahead of Fed call
Smallcap stocks outperformed the broader market with a 1.8% jump
Strong domestic direct tax collection data boosted investor sentiment
IT stocks acted as a drag on the Sensex performance
whatHappening: Net direct tax collection rose 13% to Rs 12.12 lakh crore
Jindal Supreme IPO witnessed massive demand being subscribed 181 times
Apple launched iPhone 18 in India with 20-30% higher opening sales
Government announced Semicon 2.0 scheme worth Rs 1.27 lakh crore

stocksInNews.sources: Shares sink 7.5% on margin target cut
IT sector weakness ahead of Fed call
Sensex slips into red after volatile session
Semicon 2.0 scheme to boost chip design

summary:
The Indian market showed mixed performance as the Nifty gained while the Sensex ended slightly lower ahead of the Fed meeting.
Metals and smallcap stocks led the gains, supported by strong direct tax collection and robust iPhone 18 launch sales.
Global cues remained cautious due to geopolitical tensions in Ukraine and a sharp decline in Volkswagen shares.
